name: Photo Mosaic
author: TBIT DESIGN - Thomas Breher
description: Your image, rebuilt from MANY photos - the classic photomosaic, computed entirely in your browser. Pick the main image (the whole document, any layer, or a media pick), then load tile photos from the media library (8 minimum, hundreds welcome - wedding guests, team shots, a whole folder) - or let the picture build ITSELF from crops of its own pixels. The textbook pipeline does the rest: every cell is matched against the tiles' INTERNAL 4x4 structure so the contours emerge from the photos themselves, a distance lock prevents repeats next to each other, and the COLOR MATCH slider shifts each placed photo's own pixels toward the target tone (a per-channel offset that keeps every photo fully recognizable - never an overlay). EIGHT CELL SHAPES: squares, rounded squares, dots, honeycomb, diamonds, triangles, brick bond and fish scales, with gap and corner rounding. A MASK over the whole picture - heart, circle, oval, star, hexagon, diamond, rounded - with the picture moved and zoomed inside the frame right in the preview; wheel-zoom the preview to check single tiles. Background or transparency, a tint wash, and nine presets from photo wall to heart poster. PRINT-SHARP: the inserted layer is rendered at your document's resolution from full crops of the photos - up to 160 pixels per cell - so a 30 x 60 cm poster stays crisp. Insert as an editable layer and reopen via Edit Photo Mosaic.
